sleep.title: Sleep Timer
sleep.desc: Set a listening limit. When time is up, audio gently fades out and stops, entering good-night mode so stories won't keep playing after your child falls asleep.
sleep.lockTitle: Lock screen when time is up
sleep.lockDesc: On: enters a good-night lock screen that needs the parent PIN to resume. Off: just stops; child can play again.

locked.title: 🌙 Good night, little one
locked.desc: Story time is over. Racco will stay with you — close your eyes and sleep tight~

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.intro: Read Me To Sleep respects and protects your privacy:
privacy.b1: All data (recordings, voice clones, story history) is stored only on this device
privacy.b2: We do not upload, collect, or share any personal information
privacy.b3: After deleting the app, all data is permanently erased and unrecoverable

record.title: My Recording
record.intro: Tell a story here and record it to keep it forever. It is transcribed automatically and you can edit the title; once saved it appears in My Stories · Recordings to play back anytime.
record.racco: Want to tell a story? Tap the big button to start, tap again to stop~
record.micPerm: Please allow microphone access in Settings and try again
record.noFile: No recording file was produced. Please record again.
record.tooShortMsg: Please record at least 2 seconds so we can transcribe it~
record.noTranscript: No speech recognized. You can type a title and save anyway.
